summary.result: The main results of this study are as follows; (1) The accessibility of most villages in Pyeongchang-gun is vulnerable that 81.10% for elementary school, 73.17% for middle school, and 82.32% for high school, respectively; (2) The average commuting distance per student considering estimated number of students for each educational facilities indicated 2.75km for elementary school, 4.37km for middle school, and 5.79km for high school; (3) the facility centrality index is highly correlated to educational facilities but not to village population.
summary.background: Although the educational facility are an important considerations on a social equity standpoint, educational environment in rural areas has been continuously deteriorated by numerous social problems such as decreasing birth rate and increasing of local school closing.
summary.method: Second, the implication of village population of potential accessibility is analyzed.

summary_ko.method: 두 번째로, 중심지 인구의 잠재적 접근성에 대한 의미를 분석하였다.
summary_ko.result: 본 연구의 주요 결과는 다음과 같다; (1) 평창군의 대부분 마을은 초등학교에 대해 81.10%, 중학교에 대해 73.17%, 고등학교에 대해 82.32%의 접근성이 취약한 것으로 나타났다; (2) 각 교육 시설별 예상 학생 수를 고려한 평균 통학 거리는 초등학교에 2.75km, 중학교에 4.37km, 고등학교에 5.79km였다; (3) 시설 중심지 지수는 교육 시설과 높은 상관관계를 보이나 마을 인구와는 상관관계가 낮았다.
